name: Raymond Davis
original_name: レイモンド・デイビス
source:
Star Sign: Libra
Nationality: Italian (from Milan)
Job: Former Actor (Actually a Conman)
Special Skill: Deceiving, Persuasion, Mimicking

He has a gentlemanly and soft demeanor, but also a sharp tongue.
He has exceptional insight and excels at performing. He can manipulate people's hearts with his kind smile and skillful words.
He claims the reason he joined the team was to pay back debts, but the truth of that is unknown.
[spoiler]His real name is Roy.[/spoiler]
